title: API Keys
subtitle: Manage API keys for external access
mobile_warning: Open from a computer to manage your API keys

create_dialog.title: Create New API Key
create_dialog.description: Generate a new API key to grant an external application access.

success_dialog.title: API Key Created Successfully
success_dialog.description: Please copy this key immediately. For security reasons, it will not be shown again.
success_dialog.warning: Make sure to copy your API key now. You will not be able to see it again.

delete_dialog.title: Delete API Key
delete_dialog.warning:
Are you sure you want to remove this API key? Note: The key will continue to work in connected applications. To completely disable it, the system administrator must change the Master Secret.
For more information, please visit:
https://auradash.ymzerotwo.com
delete_dialog.warning_test:
Are you sure you want to remove this API key? Note: This key is for testing only and once it expires it will no longer work. If the key is already expired, don't worry, it will not work again.
For more information, please visit:
https://auradash.ymzerotwo.com

empty_state.title: No API Keys
empty_state.description: You have not generated any API keys yet.

success.api_key_created: API key created successfully. Keep it in a secure place.

errors.missing_master_secret: System Alert: Master Secret is missing. This code is essential to secure API keys.
errors.expires_too_short: Expiration duration must be at least 1 hour.

validation.expires_too_short: Expiration duration must be at least 1 hour.
